_fl_session_config_note: EMPTY = O1-only session (the default). A pod-visible path here selects the COMBINED O1 -> Foundation Learner session; the FL package is baked into image v0.3.2+ at /opt/foundation_learner, and the named file must also be present on the pod (staged alongside the artifacts or mounted) - start_b300.sh refuses before any scientific work if either is absent. This value is DEPLOYMENT IDENTITY: it changes deployment_spec_sha256, so switching a session from O1-only to combined requires a FRESH rental authorization ceremony. Bound 2026-08-22 to the config baked with the FL source (image v0.3.11+); the first session is the COMBINED O1 -> FL session.
_profile_preference_note: Order in which the FROZEN accelerator profiles are tried. Both are covered by the rental authorization, so reordering adds no capability — it only expresses which part the operator wants FIRST. Set ["B200","B300"] to prefer the B200 (e.g. when B300 demand makes it unobtainable); the session still falls back to the other profile and records the reason. Unknown profile names are refused. First paid session: B300 FIRST, B200 retained as the explicit fallback — operator decision 2026-08-23, superseding the earlier B200-first setting. The reason that setting existed is UNCHANGED and is accepted as a known risk: sm_100 is the directly-validated path, while the sm_103 claim still rests on cuobjdump fatbinary evidence (59 sm_103a cubins, 0 PTX) that has never been exercised on hardware. It is not blind: deploy/hardware_gate.py exercises the loaded kernels on the acquired GPU before any scientific work, and with no PTX embedded a bad load fails loudly rather than silently JIT-ing. The other half of the old rationale is simply stale — secure B300 moved from NONE to LOW availability (EU-NL-1, $7.89/h) at the 2026-08-23 preflight.
